dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibiting high-frequency crenulated light-intensity perimeters. The geometries show a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity outer rings to low-intensity internal cores, with non-linear, jagged boundary paths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid-light pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These asymmetrical blobs are primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli in the posterior-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the posterior half form a non-uniform quadrilateral, with the primary axis oriented roughly 15 degrees off-parallel to the dorsal ridge line.
